meta_description:
137 likes, 0 comments - amitbhawani on August 21, 2026: "Switching from iPhone to Pixel 11 Pro XL!

Switching from my iPhone 17 Pro to the new Google Pixel 11 Pro XL!

This is the 512GB variant with 120X Pro Zoom, 8K video recording, Pro Stable Video and six months of Google AI Pro.

I’m excited about the camera, but I already have one complaint. Creator Suite includes a teleprompter, but I still want proper Cinematic Blur while recording with the front camera.

Would you switch from an iPhone to this Pixel? And what should I test first: 120X Zoom, battery or video? 👇".
